encounters.name: Grove Warden Elara
dialogue_intro: A clearing opens. In its center, a woman in weathered plate kneels, one hand pressed to the earth.
She rises slowly. Her eyes hold no hostility — only weariness.
"You've come far. Farther than most. But I cannot let you pass. The seal holds because I hold it."
She draws a blade of pale light. "Forgive me."
dialogue_outro: Elara's blade dissolves. She sinks to her knees, breathing hard.
"The seal... is failing. I've felt it for years. Maybe you're not the threat. Maybe you're the answer."
She gestures toward the ridge. "Aelin waits beyond. She will not reason with you."

encounters.name: Ashkeeper Vorn
dialogue_intro: The air grows hot. The soil is cracked and blackened, as though a fire passed through and never left.
A man stands at the center of the scorched earth. His skin is scarred, his eyes glow faintly orange.
"They told you the seal was placed by the wise. They lied. It was placed by the desperate."
Flame kindles in his palms. "And desperation leaves a mark."
dialogue_outro: The fire gutters. Vorn laughs — a dry, broken sound.
"You'll see, delver. When you reach the bottom, you'll understand why we needed to bury it."
He tosses you a fragment of coal that pulses with heat. "For when you're ready to burn."
